scripts.dev:all: pnpm --parallel --filter backend dev --filter frontend dev & pnpm --filter backend exec prisma studio
scripts.setup: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')) fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example', 'backend/.env')" && pnpm --filter backend exec prisma generate
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter backend lint
